note: Page-facing routes that no page script calls yet, each with a reason. Checked by tests/test_frontend_api_coverage.py. A branch that gives a route a screen must remove its line here. Print the report: python -m tests.frontend_api_coverage

routes.GET /api/ai/replay-status: Test-only: the server answers 404 outside the test environment.
routes.GET /api/finance-ledger/paid-through/{en: Not a gap: the Books money form loads paying accounts together with other options from /api/finance-ledger/expense-options/{entity_id}.
routes.GET /api/intake/whatsapp: Not a page: the WhatsApp provider calls this webhook address directly.
routes.GET /api/payments: Retired old money tracker: payments now live in Books.
routes.GET /api/snag-photos/{photo_id}/file: Not a gap: shown on the project page through the address the server returns with each snag.
routes.PATCH /api/costs/{cost_id}/recognize: Retired old money tracker: purchase orders and supplier bills now live in Books.
routes.POST /api/finance-ledger/legacy-expenses: Retired old money tracker: legacy expense bridge is no longer shown after the Books cut-over.
routes.POST /api/intake/whatsapp: Not a page: the WhatsApp provider calls this webhook address directly.
routes.POST /api/payments: Retired old money tracker: new payments are recorded in Books.
routes.POST /api/payments/{payment_id}/approve: Retired old money tracker: payments are approved through Books change requests.
routes.POST /api/payments/{payment_id}/reject: Retired old money tracker: payments are reviewed through Books change requests.
routes.POST /api/payments/{payment_id}/reverse: Retired old money tracker: payment reversals are recorded in Books.
